name: Click & Pledge Plugin for WooCommerce
author: ClickandPledge

sections.description:
The Click & Pledge Plugin for WooCommerce enables seamless online payment processing in your WordPress store. Once connected to your Click & Pledge account, you can securely accept credit and debit card payments.

Designed to work hand-in-hand with the WooCommerce e-commerce platform, this plugin helps you turn your WordPress site into a full-featured online store. It delivers enterprise-grade functionality, robust features, and flexible add-ons, giving you greater control over your customers’ shopping experience.

With this plugin, your WooCommerce store can easily process payments and provide your buyers with a smooth and secure checkout experience.

About Click & Pledge
Click & Pledge began on May 30, 2000, with a simple but powerful question:
What if online fundraising could be easier for everyone?

What started as a small side project to help our local community, quickly sparked a vision much larger than we ever imagined. We saw an opportunity not just to build software, but to transform the way nonprofits and donors connect.

More than 25 years later, that vision has grown into a global platform serving over 20,000 organizations and powering more than $1 billion in charitable contributions.

At Click & Pledge, we believe fundraising isn’t just a transaction, but moment of human connection. That’s why we’re committed to reimagining the giving experience from the donor’s perspective, ensuring every interaction is intuitive, meaningful, and effective.

From innovative fundraising tools to our comprehensive Academy, we empower nonprofits and partners to master both the technology and the human behavior behind successful giving.

Please note: This addon requires a Click & Pledge Account to accept credit and debit card payments. You can apply for an account at Click & Pledge. Please contact Support with any questions.
sections.installation:
Note: Click here for detailed instructions

Simply follow these steps to install:
1. Download & Unzip the file.
2. Upload the “woocommerce-clickandpledge-gateway” folder to your WordPress Plugins directory.
3. Login to your WordPress Admin, then go to Plugins and activate the “WooCommerce Click & Pledge Gateway” plugin
4. Within the WordPress Admin, go to WooCommerce >> Settings, then click on the Checkout tab, then click on the “Click & Pledge” link.
5. Enter the proper information

To use in “Live Mode”
1. Login to your WordPress Admin.
2. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Click & Pledge ( Manage ) > Register or Login/Change User.
3. We can login to new user directly with CONNECT platform through OAuth Connection. To do so, simply login with the desired CONNECT User Name.
4. Enter the CONNECT User Name associated with your Click & Pledge account and click on Get the Code. Please check your email inbox for the email. Copy and Paste the code and click Login.
5. After successful login, you will see the Click & Pledge accounts listed in the C&P Account ID.
6. Based on the Account ID selected, the settings which are set in the CONNECT platform will be appear here.
7. After making all the changes click on “Save Changes” button. Your website/shopping cart is now setup to process transactions via your Click & Pledge account. We recommend that you process a test transaction, then login to your Click & Pledge account to confirm that it appears in your account.

To use in “Test Mode”
1. Login to your WordPress Admin.
2. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Click & Pledge ( Manage ) > Register or Login/Change User.
3. We can login to new user directly with CONNECT platform through OAuth Connection. To do so, simply login with the desired CONNECT User Name.
4. Enter the CONNECT User Name associated with your Click & Pledge account and click on Get the Code. Please check your email inbox for the email. Copy and Paste the code and click Login.
5. After successful login, you will see the Click & Pledge accounts listed in the C&P Account ID.
6. Based on the Account ID selected, the settings which are set in the CONNECT platform will be appear here.
7. After making all the changes click on “Save Changes” button. Your website/shopping cart is now setup to process transactions via your Click & Pledge account. We recommend that you process a test transaction, then login to your Click & Pledge account to confirm that it appears in your account.
